g.text: Illustrative model: latency is flat until a resource saturates, then only the queue grows

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: Illustrative queueing models, not vendor data. A: M/M/1, mean = S/(1-ρ), percentile q = S·ln(1/(1-q))/(1-ρ). B: requests land on random dies; IOPS = busy dies ÷ 80 µs; latency = QD ÷ IOPS
